summary: Full frontend flow testing of the new /suppliers page: page load, SAP sync error banner, supplier master CRUD (add/edit/delete/search/empty-name validation), part<->supplier assignment CRUD (add 2 suppliers to same product with Preferred/Backup, edit with locked supplier field, delete, product-id scoping/no cross-contamination), and regression smoke-check of all other nav tabs (BOM Explorer, Purchasing Plan, Production Plan, Inventory, Admin). All test-created data was cleaned up after testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Interacting with the Radix Select dropdowns (assignment-form-supplier-select, assignment-form-preference-select) intermittently triggers a benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' error which CRA's dev error overlay intercepts and displays as a full-screen red 'Uncaught runtime errors' iframe, blocking further clicks until dismissed (Escape). This is a known harmless browser/CRA-dev-overlay quirk (will NOT appear in production build), but worth noting since it degraded automated/manual click-testing in the preview environment.

action_items: No functional fixes required for the Suppliers feature - all flows work correctly.

Optional/low-priority: consider disabling CRA's dev error overlay for ResizeObserver loop warnings (common false positive with Radix Select) to avoid confusing screen takeovers during dev/testing; not an issue in prod build.
critical_code_review_comments: SuppliersPage.js is 680 lines - functional but on the larger side; could be split into SupplierMasterList and PartSupplierAssignments sub-components for maintainability, though not urgent.

Good practices observed: proper loading/error/success toast states on every API call, data-testid coverage is thorough and consistent, empty states handled well, supplier dropdown correctly disabled during assignment edit (prevents changing supplier for existing PK), sync failure surfaces both a toast AND persistent banner with actionable detail message from backend.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth required for this app/feature
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: 2 test suppliers (TEST_Acme Supplies, TEST_Global Parts Co) and 2 part-supplier assignments against product IDs TEST-PART-1/TEST-PART-2. All test data deleted after verification (confirmed via GET /api/suppliers returning empty array).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suppliers page (new feature) fully verified end-to-end: master list CRUD, search/filter, sync-from-SAP expected-failure banner (backend returns 424 with clear detail, takes ~5-8s due to SOAP client retry/timeout before failing - not instant), part<->supplier assignment CRUD with Preferred/Backup badges, product-id scoping (no cross-contamination confirmed), and supplier-select correctly locked during assignment edit. No regressions found on BOM Explorer, Purchasing Plan, Production Plan, Inventory, or Admin nav tabs (all load without crash). Only note: CRA dev-mode error overlay pops up on ResizeObserver warnings when clicking Radix Selects rapidly - purely a dev/preview cosmetic issue, dismissible via Escape, not present in production builds.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found requiring RCA. The one observed issue (ResizeObserver overlay) is a well-known CRA dev-server + Radix UI interaction quirk unrelated to app logic.
